body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity on non-current maps**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; with Biomes! Caverns = living cavern.
- Stairwells do NOT exchange heat (run-14).
- Sky-view mountain = ONE connected vanilla rock texture per stone type (run #17, re-verified); **BM variant mode is the sanctioned exception (USER-VERIFIED)**.
- **OUTERMOST RING OF ANY SKY MASS IS ALWAYS AB_MountainTop lip**; hidden-valley breach notches preserve this.
- **MINED PEAK EXPOSES OPEN SKY**: `level == 1` gates must become "topmost level" if more levels land.
- **Pod transit handoff LATE**: HandoffTicksToImpact = 22.
- **DEPTH/HEIGHT CUES RETIRED (run #50)**: below view PLUMB, dim 0.06, hairlines, reveal.
- **Mesa model rejected**; stacked maps stay.
- **ALWAYS read `def.graphicData.Graphic`, never the stale `def.graphic` field** (run-53; lore).
- **Settings IMGUI discipline**: deferred tab/expando switches, snapshot-gated rows, maxOneColumn + measured heights + unconditional gutter.
- **Cross-level work migrates only for STRICTLY better-ranked work** (index in the pawn's own WorkGiversInOrderNormal); equal rank stays local (user-approved 2026-07-22). Async/actors/AOT explicitly rejected for job scanning — main-thread sim only.
- **CrossLevelDemand skips Blueprint_Install** (no material cost; asking logs a vanilla error — fixed + verified run #62).
- **TEXTURE POLICY (2026-07-22, user-directed)**: user supplies ALL stair/ladder/elevator art — agent must NOT regenerate it. Stairs/grand stairs/wide stairs/ladders rotatable (Graphic_Multi); elevator NOT rotatable (Graphic_Single). Risers have NO custom art: vanilla/host-mod linked atlases on the Conduits altitude layer.
- **Climb animations: vanilla pipeline only (2026-07-23, user-approved)**: native AnimationDef + BaseAnimationWorker; installed animation frameworks explicitly NOT used.

## 2026-07-23 TRANCHE 2 — BUILT (compile green), awaiting in-game check
### Achtung! compat (ABAchtungCompat, Compat/)
Cross-level formation drags. Root cause: Achtung's Colonist.UpdateOrderPos validates slots against the PAWN's map and Tools.OrderTo issues the Goto there — with our plumb shared coordinates a drag while viewing another level walks pawns to the same cell on the WRONG level (or drops them). Fix: by-name prefix on `AchtungMod.Colonist.OrderTo(Vector3)` — pawn on a DIRECTLY linked level of the viewed map -> skip Achtung, route via stairs (CrossLevelOrders.RouteThenRun + ABPendingOrders), drafted Goto to the formation slot on arrival (playerForced, collideWithPawns=false, re-anchored standable). Per-pawn slot dedup for drag streams (128-cap dict). Same-map pawns keep Achtung's path -> mixed selections converge on one line. Two-away pawns + forced-work system: out of scope, Achtung untouched. Gates: ABDetect brrainz.achtung, ABGuard.Movement, crossLevelOrders toggle, fails open.
### Meditation across levels (Patch_Meditate_CrossLevel, Logistics/MeditationAcrossLevels.cs) — user bug
Root cause: MeditationUtility.AllMeditationSpotCandidates is map-scoped; assigned spot on another level invisible -> meditate in place. Fix: postfix JobGiver_Meditate.TryGiveJob — result non-null + no assigned spot on own map + assigned spot (MeditationSpot via GetAssignedPawn, or ownership.AssignedThrone) elsewhere in column -> one hop toward it (dest = spot pos on direct link); arrival re-runs giver, vanilla +200 assigned bias picks the spot. Assigned-spot-on-own-map stays vanilla's business (mirrors rest redirect). No assigned spot anywhere -> vanilla in-place + 300t cooldown. Gates: crossLevelNeeds, ABGuard.Logistics, EligibleColonist.
### Construction supply deadlock (WorkGiver_ABSupplyConstruction + AB_SupplyConstructionAcrossLevels def) — user bug
Root cause: materials only moved down via Hauling work type at LOWEST priority (any local haul preempts forever) or via a hauler already idle ON the demanding level; builders never descend because the probe rightly finds nothing doable on a level with no materials. Deadlock: dug-out basement + full surface stockpiles + zero progress. Fix: NonScan giver in the CONSTRUCTION work type (priorityInType 5, after all local construction): linked level's blueprints/frames need def X that my level has + can spare (quantity-aware ExportAllowed) -> builder carries a stack through the stairs (AB_HaulAcrossLevels job); FinishCarriedDelivery drops/stores on arrival, builder is now ON the construction level where the local scan finds deliver/build work. **CrossLevelDemand gained a constructionNeed sub-dict** (blueprints/frames only; FindFetchableDemand constructionOnly param) so builders don't adopt bill/meal logistics. Gates: crossLevelSupply, ABGuard.Logistics, LowPowerWorker, 450t empty-scan cooldown, VirtualScanActive recursion guard.

## ART TUNER (2026-07-23) — BUILT, awaiting in-game use
"DEV: Adjust art" gizmo on Building_ABStairs (ShowDevGizmos): live drawSize X/Y (square lock, ±0.01) + per-facing offset X/Z (shared offset for elevator); mutates def.graphicData, clears cachedGraphic (reflection), Notify_ColorChanged all instances all maps. **Bake all** -> `Tools/ArtTuning.xml` + log. WORKFLOW: user tunes -> bakes -> agent folds into Defs/Buildings/AB_Stairs.xml -> deletes file.

## CLIMB/EMERGE ANIMATIONS + WIDE STAIRS (2026-07-23) — BUILT, awaiting in-game check
Two AnimationDefs (AB_Climb/AB_Emerge, Root node) + procedural BaseAnimationWorkers reading ABClimbState snapshots (ConcurrentDictionary, main-thread writes, parallel-pre-draw-safe reads). Step bob + ±3° lean (stairs), taller slower rung bob (ladders, `ladder` flag on ABStairsExtension), smoothstep slide onto stairwell, sink −0.35z ×0.72 down / rise +0.30z ×1.10 up; 22t emerge flourish on arrival. Wired into all three climb toils + StairTransfer. Elevators excluded. Never stomps foreign CurAnimation; ABGameComp janitor; 60t stall auto-hide; climbAnimations toggle (view tab). **Wide stairs**: AB_WideStairsDown/Up, 2x1 rotatable Graphic_Multi reusing normal stairs art at (2,1), climbFactor 0.8, 150 stuff, 6400 work, no quality.

## TEXTURE / ROTATION REWORK (2026-07-22) — user stair art DROPPED, placement tuning via art tuner pending
Stairs/grand stairs Graphic_Multi clean base paths; elevator Graphic_Single. Riser graphics on host-mod/vanilla atlases (power conduit vanilla PowerConduit_Atlas; DBH SewagePipe_Atlas Custom5; VCHE ChemfuelPipes_Atlas Custom7; Rimefeller oilPipe_Atlas Custom6; VEF PSTransmitterAtlas linkFlags None). AB_VerticalLinkBase on Conduits layer. **WATCH AT SYNC**: foreign texPaths must not get magenta stubs (would shadow host art).

## MECH ESCORT CROSS-LEVEL FOLLOW — BUILT 2026-07-22, awaiting in-game check
Patch_MechEscortFollow_CrossLevel: postfix JobGiver_AIFollowOverseer.TryGiveJob — null result + overseer on linked level -> destination-aware stairs job; arrival re-runs escort branch. ABGuard.Movement + crossLevelOrders, no lord, 250t cooldown.

## PRIORITY-AWARE CROSS-LEVEL WORK — USER-VERIFIED run #62 (both directions)
Tier 1 idle migration + Tier 2 priority-aware (strictly-better rank via WorkGiversInOrderNormal index, truncated virtual probe, `priorityCrossLevelWork` toggle). Perf: LevelWorkSummary per-map bool[] TTL 600 + ~17 real detectors (fail open); event-driven invalidation (AddDesignation postfix bumps WorkVersion); VersionedCooldown 900t; probe budget 2/tick; AB-giver recursion skip; 300-cell caps; 1200t migration cooldown.

## MISC. ROBOTS COMPAT — USER-VERIFIED run #62
5 AIRobot return/recharge givers postfixed (DeclaredMethod, by-name): null + bound station on linked level -> stairs toward it, 450t cooldown. LowPowerWorker guard in both cross-level haul givers (rest <45% / mech energy <35%). Stairs float menu open to ToolUser pawns.

## SETTINGS + GEN-CONTROL SUITE (2026-07-22) — BUILT, awaiting responsiveness pass
Five tabs, measured scrolls, presets, ABGuard panel + Re-arm, gen knobs + seeded live preview, Odyssey sky landmarks (4-state ladders, VLE soft). climbAnimations checkbox added.
**PLANNED (user, 2026-07-23): job-scan tuning tab** — finer control of cross-level job tick/scan cadence. Brainstorm delivered (aggressiveness levers: cooldown/TTL scaling, probe budget, per-flow toggles, preset Relaxed/Default/Eager/Frantic); awaiting user direction before build.

## Below-view rendering (USER-VERIFIED): plumb transform, dim 0.06, hairline skirt, wall-top reveal, below-print anchor first air cell, shrink exemptions.
## COMPAT (USER-VERIFIED): sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode.
## PARITY TRANCHE COMPLETE (#1-#15); pod transit + AA verified #39. 2026-07-21: stair routing, BC caverns, naturalistic peaks (#47), camera level lock.

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; combat/auto-engage/targeting-hub/animal-wander/ritual-attendance/mech-overseer/bond+home/pod-transit/stair-routing/cavern-basement/peak-plateau self-tests; below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell; cap corner fillers; DEV: Adjust art (bake to Tools/ArtTuning.xml).

## Prior verified features (unchanged)
Select in place; bidirectional right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; cross-level power/pipes; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; opt-in threats; world integration; modder API.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). Better Mountains (verified). Medieval Overhaul (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots + Robots++ (USER-VERIFIED). **Achtung! formation drags (soft, NEW 2026-07-23, untested)**. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23: tranche 2 built (Achtung drags, meditation redirect, construction supply giver) + climb animations + wide stairs + art tuner — ALL awaiting one combined in-game check. Aggressiveness brainstorm delivered; job-scan settings tab awaiting user direction. Outstanding: art bake fold-in, mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, Forced smoke-vent gen, bond/home, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
